acs.text_first_line: A granted ledger read answers with the field markers
Every channel of one case gets one answer
A field with an unmasked row comes back clear and the rest stays masked
A case outside the reader's scope is not found
A role without Case record R is refused
The access log answers who read which ledger
An agent reads the ledger under the same decision
An answer that cannot be recorded is not given
A new masking version changes the answer with no deployment
